# TinkerHub CEAL

> TinkerHub CEAL is a student-led community at College of Engineering Attingal (CEAL), dedicated to fostering a culture of peer-to-peer learning, technology exploration, and real-world project building.

## Community Overview

- **Organization**: TinkerHub CEAL (Campus Chapter of TinkerHub Foundation)
- **Institution**: College of Engineering Attingal (CEAL), Kerala, India
- **Motto**: Learn • Build • Share
- **Mission**: Bridge the gap between academic education and industry standards by empowering students across all engineering and science disciplines to build innovative solutions, learn together, and share knowledge.
- **Key Statistics**:
  - 200+ Active Community Members
  - 40+ Tech Events, Workshops & Hackathons organized
  - 70+ Projects created by community members
- **Website**: [https://tinkerhub.ceal.in](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in)
- **Primary Technologies & Focus Areas**: Web Development, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Agentic AI, Backend & System Design, Game Development, Hardware & Maker Projects, Cybersecurity, UI/UX Design, Open Source Contribution.

---

## Site Map & Core Pages

- [Home Page](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/): Landing page featuring community motto, hero gallery, video highlights, upcoming event teasers, and impact metrics.
- [About Us](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/about/): Detailed background on TinkerHub CEAL, community mission, peer-to-peer learning philosophy, and goals.
- [Events Catalog](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/events/): Complete filterable catalog of upcoming and past community events, hackathons, and workshops.
- [Our Team](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/team/): Directory of the 2026 Core Leadership Team, Faculty Coordinators, and Volunteers.
- [Member Profiles](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/profile/): Dynamic member cards displaying quotes, fields of interest, skills, and personal social links (accessible via hash e.g., `https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/profile/#lekshmy`).
- [Quick Links Hub](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/link/): Linktree-style directory linking to all official social channels and community portals.

## Community Events & Hackathons

### Upcoming & Featured Events
- **Useless Project 3.0** (September 05, 2026 | 09:00 AM)
  - *Description*: A fun, creative hackathon encouraging participants to build absurd and hilarious tech projects.
- **Code A Pookalam** (August 19, 2026 | 08:00 PM)
  - *Description*: Virtual festival event challenging participants to create digital Pookalam flower carpets purely using code.
- **Kulfi** (August 06, 2026 | 03:50 PM)
  - *Description*: Official TinkerHub CEAL orientation and welcome session for new community members.
- **RBI Reelathon 2026: Orientation** (July 22, 2026 | 02:00 PM)
  - *Description*: Orientation session conducted in partnership with RBI Trivandrum focusing on digital reel creation and cyber money fraud awareness.

### Flagship & Past Highlights
- **TinkHerHack 4.0** (February 20, 2026 | 09:00 AM)
  - *Description*: All-women flagship hackathon promoting gender diversity, technical mentorship, and impactful software/hardware solutions.
- **Project Building** (February 07, 2026 | 02:00 PM)
  - *Description*: Interactive hands-on session focusing on MVP (Minimum Viable Product) development and project ideation.
- **Craft & Learn** (August 19, 2025 | 11:00 AM)
  - *Description*: Maker meetup where students experiment with hardware, design tools, and peer-to-peer skill sharing.
- **Useless Project 2.0** (August 08, 2025 | 09:30 AM)
  - *Description*: Iteration of the signature creative hackathon celebrating absurd and humorous technology projects.
- **Pixel to Product** (July 28, 2025 | 10:00 AM)
  - *Description*: Comprehensive UI/UX workshop bridging the gap between pixel-perfect UI design and product handoff.

## Structured Data Endpoints (JSON)

For automated systems and API clients, the following raw JSON feeds are available:

- [Events Data Feed](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/static/json/events.json): Raw list of all events, dates, descriptions, and media assets.
- [Team Roster Data Feed](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/static/json/team.json): Raw team structure grouped by year, positions, quotes, interests, and socials.
- [Links Data Feed](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/static/json/links.json): Raw social and platform links.
- [Gallery Data Feed](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/static/json/gallery.json): Hero gallery images and video media items.
- [XML Sitemap](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/sitemap.xml): Standard XML sitemap listing site URLs.
- [Robots File](https://tinkerhub.ceal.in/robots.txt): Standard site crawler rules.
